description_en: Use `DescribeRefreshTaskById` to check if refresh and prefetch tasks are complete across the network
description_zh: 调用DescribeRefreshTaskById查询刷新状态和预热状态是否在全网生效
name: DescribeRefreshTaskById

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the task to query.

You can obtain the `task ID` from the response of the `RefreshObjectCaches` API to query the status of a refresh or preload task.

You can specify up to 10 `task ID`s, separated by commas
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的任务ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91164.html接口，从其返回值中获取刷新预热的任务ID，并通过任务ID查询源站资源的刷新状态。

支持同时传入多个任务ID，多个任务ID之间用英文逗号（,）分隔，最多支持同时传入10个任务ID
parameters.name: task_id

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the task was created. The time is in UTC
CreationTime.description_zh: 任务对象创建时间，使用UTC时间表示

Description.description_en:
The error description that is returned if the refresh or preload task fails. Valid values:

Internal Error: An internal error occurs.

Origin Timeout: The origin server times out.

Origin Return StatusCode 5XX: The origin server returns a 5xx status code
Description.description_zh:
刷新预热失败后返回的错误描述。取值：
Internal Error：内部错误。
Origin Timeout：源站响应超时。
Origin Return StatusCode 5XX：源站响应5xx错误码

ObjectPath.description_en: The path of the object that is refreshed

ObjectType.description_en:
The type of the task. Valid values:

file: Refreshes a single file.

directory: Refreshes a directory.

preload: Preloads a single file.

regex: Refreshes content based on a regular expression
ObjectType.description_zh:
任务类型。取值：
file：单文件刷新。
directory：目录刷新。
preload：单文件预热。
regex：正则刷新

Process.description_en: The progress of the task in percentage

Status.description_en:
The status of the task. Valid values:

Complete: The task is completed.

Refreshing: The task is in progress.

Timeout: The task timed out.

Canceled: The task is canceled.

Failed: The task failed
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。取值：

Complete：完成。
Refreshing：处理中。
Timeout：超时未执行。
Canceled：取消。
Failed：失败
